title: A multi-omics approach to understand and predict therapeutic success of anti-TNF and anti-integrin agents in inflammatory bowel disease
description: In this study we wanted to identify baseline predictors of successful anti-TNF and vedolizumab therapy in patients with inflammatory bowel disease (based on tissue transcriptomics and CD4/CD14 transcriptomics)

samples.title: GC049947
samples.description: Protocols: We collected inflamed colonic and ileal biopsies, as well as blood (of which PBMCs were isolated and sorted through FACS) prior to the initiation of anti-TNF and Vedolizumab therapy. All recruited Crohn's disease patients had endoscopy-proven active disease (SES-CD > 7, and > 4 in patients with pure ileal involvement); all included UC patients had a Mayo endoscopic subscore 2-3. Total RNA from lysed inflamed biopsies and lysed sorted CD4+ and CD14+ cells was extracted using the AllPrep DNA/RNA Mini kit (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany) according to the manufacturer's instructions. The integrity and quantity of all RNA was assessed with a 2100 Bioanalyzer (Agilent, Waldbronn, Germany) and a Nanodrop ND-1000 spectrophotometer (Thermo Scientific, Waltham, Massachusetts, USA). Library preparation was performed using the TruSeq Stranded mRNA protocol (Illumina, San Diego, USA) according to the manufacturer's instructions.

Protocols: We collected inflamed colonic and ileal biopsies, as well as blood (of which PBMCs were isolated and sorted through FACS) prior to the initiation of anti-TNF and Vedolizumab therapy.
All recruited Crohn's disease patients had endoscopy-proven active disease (SES-CD > 7, and > 4 in patients with pure ileal involvement); all included UC patients had a Mayo endoscopic subscore 2-3.

samples.title: GC050242
samples.description: Protocols: We collected inflamed colonic and ileal biopsies, as well as blood (of which PBMCs were isolated and sorted through FACS) prior to the initiation of anti-TNF and Vedolizumab therapy. All recruited Crohn's disease patients had endoscopy-proven active disease (SES-CD > 7, and > 4 in patients with pure ileal involvement); all included UC patients had a Mayo endoscopic subscore 2-3. Total RNA from lysed inflamed biopsies and lysed sorted CD4+ and CD14+ cells was extracted using the AllPrep DNA/RNA Mini kit (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany) according to the manufacturer's instructions. The integrity and quantity of all RNA was assessed with a 2100 Bioanalyzer (Agilent, Waldbronn, Germany) and a Nanodrop ND-1000 spectrophotometer (Thermo Scientific, Waltham, Massachusetts, USA). Library preparation was performed using the TruSeq Stranded mRNA protocol (Illumina, San Diego, USA) according to the manufacturer's instructions.

Protocols: We collected inflamed colonic and ileal biopsies, as well as blood (of which PBMCs were isolated and sorted through FACS) prior to the initiation of anti-TNF and Vedolizumab therapy.
All recruited Crohn's disease patients had endoscopy-proven active disease (SES-CD > 7, and > 4 in patients with pure ileal involvement); all included UC patients had a Mayo endoscopic subscore 2-3.

samples.title: GC050292
samples.description: Protocols: We collected inflamed colonic and ileal biopsies, as well as blood (of which PBMCs were isolated and sorted through FACS) prior to the initiation of anti-TNF and Vedolizumab therapy. All recruited Crohn's disease patients had endoscopy-proven active disease (SES-CD > 7, and > 4 in patients with pure ileal involvement); all included UC patients had a Mayo endoscopic subscore 2-3. Total RNA from lysed inflamed biopsies and lysed sorted CD4+ and CD14+ cells was extracted using the AllPrep DNA/RNA Mini kit (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany) according to the manufacturer's instructions. The integrity and quantity of all RNA was assessed with a 2100 Bioanalyzer (Agilent, Waldbronn, Germany) and a Nanodrop ND-1000 spectrophotometer (Thermo Scientific, Waltham, Massachusetts, USA). Library preparation was performed using the TruSeq Stranded mRNA protocol (Illumina, San Diego, USA) according to the manufacturer's instructions.
